edges.evidence: The PNG displays a single logo icon.
A prominent uppercase N is centered in the logo.
The central N is enclosed by a thick circular ring.
The ring transitions from purple to gold/yellow.
The N is rendered in a silver metallic gradient.
Both the N and ring show bevels, shadows, and glossy highlights.
The area outside and inside the logo ring appears transparent in the PNG preview.
